scope: Focused and held-out native comparisons on the same Apple arm64 host; targeted matrix, not workload-frequency estimates.
best_control_definition: Fastest median of process medians among production baseline, Phi1, and available fixed common-K1 variants, excluding all selectors. Focus has fixed8/16/32/64; holdout has fixed16/32/64. Cases with best control <=0.01ms excluded. Optimistic hindsight comparison, not a deployable policy.
memory_scope: Measured vector capacities only, not RSS. Conservative scratch peak accounts for sequential Phi/stream phases; excludes thread stacks, allocator overhead, shared Phi cache and other process allocations.
interpretation: Displayed timings are medians of process medians. Changes are medians of paired block ratios/differences; they need not equal ratios/differences of displayed medians. Every-block direction is descriptive, not a statistical significance claim.
recommendation: Advance the frozen consolidated selector as the first policy for maintainer review, not as a proven universal optimum. Retain one common K1 queue, the shared large-input caps, and conservative small-parallel guards; do not route permanently among v1/v2/v3 or refit thresholds from this matrix. The held-out results retain the large complete-call gains with no predeclared material regression flags. Production adoption still requires discussing the recurring ~0.079ms first-call scheduler tradeoff and accepting deliberately missed streaming gains for enlarged tables. The strict L==isqrt(x) gate is intentionally conservative and has a visible performance discontinuity for 0.1% enlargement; it is an empirical safety boundary, not a mathematical crossover. No retuning or production edits were made.

complete_choice_control.interpretation: Complete-call first/warm differences among v2,v3,candidate do not demonstrate a better dispatch decision: every focused complete case selects the same partition and worker budgets in all three. Binary/code-layout and runtime variation remain possible contributors.

own_choice_control_coverage: 144 of146 candidate first/warm comparisons have the exact nominal Phi1/fixedK control; the held-out short-full-range case selects8L and has no fixed8 executable in its cohort. Full per-case control tables remain available.
